question: Has the production `clawsweeper-state-snapshots` R2 bucket been provisioned, and should this Worker binding merge only after a successful deployed end-to-end parity run?
rationale: The missing resource is external deployment state rather than a repository-only repair, and it determines whether this otherwise opt-in path can be safely deployed.

options.title: Provision and verify first
options.body: Create the R2 bucket, deploy the Worker binding, and require redacted export, hydration, journal, and parity evidence before merging.

options.title: Defer the binding
options.body: Keep the Worker transport code off the deployment path until the production storage resource and operational proof are ready.

recommendation.title: Provision and verify first
recommendation.body: Create the R2 bucket, deploy the Worker binding, and require redacted export, hydration, journal, and parity evidence before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR commit and deployment contract connect steipete most directly to the proposed snapshot-store rollout.
